name: SkySend
description: SkySend is a self-hosted file and note sharing service. Files and notes are encrypted in the browser before they are stored, and the server keeps only encrypted blobs.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  skysend:
    image: skyfay/skysend:v3.2.0@sha256:f2d71b93ba103be1dfad3ee1fa6aa7bcde8a4dc199d9f13ac18d78c3c93b1a91
    container_name: skysend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/uploads:/uploads
    environment:
      BASE_URL: http://localhost:23001
      DATA_DIR: /data
      UPLOADS_DIR: /uploads
